name: deutsch-auf-c1-android
description: Self-contained Android package for Deutsch auf C1

scripts.android:init: npm run prepare:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug-apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release-apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
